instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, inspired by the farm-themed visual language of franquias como Peppa Pig, O Show da Luna!, Turma da Mônica, Fazenda do Zenon e Bob Esponja, positioned in the foreground with a strong central presence in a 9:16 frame. The envelope is handcrafted, premium and refined, made of soft watercolor-inspired paper in gentle pastel shades of baby blue, blush pink, butter yellow, mint green, lavender and warm cream. Subtle paper fibers, delicate painted brushstrokes, pearlescent accents and elegant folds create a tactile, artisanal finish. A charming wax seal features a tiny barn, smiling farm animal or rustic rooster emblem, with a soft pastel ribbon and miniature ornamental details. The envelope rests in a rich, story-driven fazendinha environment rather than a flat backdrop: a cozy red barn, wooden fence, rolling green hills, wheat fields, a small vegetable garden, hay bales and a winding countryside path, softly blurred but clearly recognizable. Surrounding elements include watercolor-style daisies, sunflowers, little clouds, butterflies, floating petals, tiny chicks, a lamb, a friendly calf and subtle glowing dust, arranged organically without overpowering the envelope. The scene feels joyful, innocent, welcoming and magical, with a handcrafted children’s invitation aesthetic and soft storybook charm. Cinematic lighting with a gentle warm key light, delicate rim light along the envelope edges and diffused volumetric sunlight filtering through pastel clouds. Soft atmospheric haze, light mist and floating watercolor-like particles enhance depth and enchantment. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional. Intentional harmonious palette of watercolor pastels, low saturation, smooth gradients, luminous highlights and controlled contrast. Composition: envelope sharply in focus, centered in the foreground, background softly defocused, strong depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture, wax seal, ribbon and painted farm ornaments, dreamy cinematic bokeh. Style: photorealistic materials combined with whimsical watercolor illustration details, hyper-detailed cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, sweet, playful, premium and visually enchanting. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic paper materials, global illumination, soft volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, editorial-grade rendering. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Avoid harsh neon colors, dark horror elements, clutter, flat backgrounds, distorted anatomy, unreadable text, logos and excessive saturation.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a blank white sheet of paper as the main subject, positioned vertically in the foreground and occupying almost the entire frame while preserving visible space around it to reveal the floor, background and lateral decorative elements. The sheet must remain completely empty, clean and free of any text, writing, symbols, logos or illustrations, with a refined matte paper texture, subtle fibers, softly rounded or naturally irregular edges, and realistic gentle folds. Surrounding the sheet, create a charming watercolor-inspired farm setting with delicate handcrafted adornments: tiny pastel flowers, soft green leaves, wheat stalks, small wooden fence details, miniature hay bales, rustic farm tools, butterflies, light feathers and subtle farm-themed ornaments arranged organically along the borders without covering the central writing area. Include discreet, adorable countryside elements on the lateral sides, such as a small red barn, friendly farm animals like a lamb, chick, piglet, cow and rabbit, rendered as elegant miniature decorative figurines or softly painted details, keeping them secondary to the blank sheet. The sheet rests on a softly textured rustic wooden or warm beige farmhouse floor, with visible ground perspective and gentle shadows. In the background, reveal a softly defocused watercolor countryside scene with rolling green fields, a charming red barn, wooden fences, trees, blue sky and warm pastoral atmosphere, visually recognizable but never competing with the central paper. Color palette: soft watercolor tones, pastel green, pale yellow, dusty pink, baby blue, warm cream, muted terracotta and gentle lavender, with delicate washes, smooth gradients and harmonious low contrast. Lighting is soft, dreamy and cinematic, with diffused morning sunlight, subtle volumetric rays, delicate rim light around the paper, realistic contact shadows, mild atmospheric haze and tiny floating dust particles. Composition: central blank sheet sharply in focus, nearly full-screen, clear safe area for writing, visible floor and lateral margins, strong depth and perspective, balanced vertical framing. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture and foreground ornaments, soft cinematic bokeh in the farm background. Style: photorealistic watercolor fantasy realism, delicate children’s storybook aesthetic, premium stationery design, charming farmhouse atmosphere, elegant, magical and inviting. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, soft volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, clean composition, no text, no watermark, no clutter. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, suitable for a premium farm-themed invitation, printable stationery or storytelling visual. Franchises: Peppa Pig, Turma da Mônica, Galinha Pintadinha, Shaun the Sheep, Disney, Pixar, Studio Ghibli.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão vertical 9:16 elegante, na mesma atmosfera, no tema (Fazendinha) e na paleta de cores (Cores aquarela e suaves). Como identificação do evento, escreva apenas "julia 1 Ano". Escreva também a frase exata "Clique para abrir o convite!". Você não deve acrescentar data, horário, endereço ou outros dizeres, e deixe-as visíveis, legíveis e integradas ao design.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
